ingredientRanking.toxtricity nature note: Toxtricity forms incompatible with the selected nature are excluded.
ingredientRanking.cross ranking pattern note: Every ingredient configuration for each Pokémon is ranked as a separate candidate.
ingredientRanking.ranking uses selected levels: Uses the ranking level above and each comparison Pokémon's actual level.
